description: Cipher learning, Focus combat ownership, Reaping Knives and progression in the real engine on BG2EE/ToB including campaign-legal high levels.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Cipher, the read-only checkpoint helper and two legally created Cipher actors.
Controlled hostile and friendly targets with normal hits, critical hits and misses observed in real combat.
Ordinary and temple rest access, a second area and local saves; XP grants only prepare real level-up screens.
Independent installed-rule oracles for Focus gain/cap/cost, learning credits, tier unlocks and Reaping Knives ownership/expiry.
Before preparation, hash and read installed XPCAP and XPLEVEL rows; derive attainable levels from those resources. Controlled XP may reach the installed cap but must not change or bypass it.

Real BG2EE data with ToB available for high-level preparation; record the active campaign and preserve legally created actors. Low/middle checkpoints may resume genuine campaign-start or imported lower-level saves; never overwrite component/class levels.
instructions: Record starting Focus and before/after Focus for hostile normal/critical hits, misses and friendly attacks; reach the cap and attempt further gain.
Exercise power learning confirm/cancel, casting/spending, target cancellation and quickslot casting through the actual UI.
Use two Ciphers to check Reaping Knives credit owner, transfer, expiry and save/reload without cross-credit. Record both actors' Focus and the recipient/owner state.
Use real low/middle/high level-up screens; independently verify new tier credits and eligibility at levels 16 and 19.
Compare observed Focus/powers after ordinary rest, temple rest, an area transition and save/reload with the documented reset/persistence rules. Quit normally.
